data.one_liner: A Flutter button widget with an integrated timer for resending OTP codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable button that starts a countdown timer when pressed, preventing users from spamming OTP resend requests. It supports controllers for handling asynchronous operations like loading states before the timer begins.
use_when: You need an OTP resend button with a countdown timer
You want to show a loading state while waiting for an OTP request response
avoid_when: You only need standard buttons without any timer functionality
strengths: Easy to implement with minimal setup
Includes a controller to manage loading and timer states dynamically
Supports customizable styles, durations, and button types
weaknesses: Very narrow and specific use case
data.minimal_example:
OtpTimerButtonController controller = OtpTimerButtonController();

OtpTimerButton(
  controller: controller,
  onPressed: () {},
  text: Text('Resend OTP'),
  duration: 60,
)
